svg.title: Lattice
svg.desc: Lattice: a Matrix client with Discord-like channels, crisp screen sharing with audio and better calls, for the desktop and Android.

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Channels, calls and crisp screen sharing on Matrix.
Desktop (Linux, Windows) and Android · based on Element · formerly InterCom
